text: Muskmelon (locally ត្រសក់ផ្អែម, netted-skin cantaloupe types) is grown in Cambodia using two named commercial varieties, K2122 and T778. Growers should choose a site with well-drained, fertile soil, reliable access to water, good sun exposure, and no flood risk, and it should be reasonably close to the farmer's house for daily monitoring. Seed should be sourced from a known supplier with a documented germination rate, disease tolerance, and suitability to local climate conditions before purchase.
caveat: Exact germination-rate and disease-resistance figures for K2122/T778 were not legibly recoverable from the source scan; only variety names and general selection criteria are confirmed.
